body.statement: The total division operation \(\oslash\) and each coordinate of \(H_x\) are finite semialgebraic functions, while \(F_L\), \(F_U\), and \(m\) are continuous, positively homogeneous, globally Lipschitz, and piecewise linear on a finite polyhedral complex over all of \(\mathbb R^{2K}\). For every \(b\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{obs}}\) and \(g\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal J}\), \(d_b(g)=\partial_+\bar\Phi(b;g)\) exists and is finite: ordinary quotient rules apply to positive instrument cells, while positive homogeneity together with \(u\oslash0=0\) supplies the ray derivative at empty cells. The map \((b,g)\mapsto d_b(g)\) is jointly semialgebraic and Borel on \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{obs}}\times\mathbb R^{\mathcal J}\).
body.justification: Finite capacity geometry is the reduction that avoids division by vanishing cell-specific survivor masses.
body.gap: Generic directional-delta results do not supply the zero-cell rational limit or the model-specific finite capacity-face decomposition.
body.consumer: The legal-face optimizer can enumerate all support and tie configurations needed for reproducible calibration.
